notes.title: v2.3.0 - Powerup Rebalancing
notes.content:
Mostly some powerup tuning to even out the playing field between powerups, focusing on the removal of most lures and punishing abusing infinite healing

Settings

 added the ability to make the bullet cover black in addition to the other options

Modifiers
Final Trial

 now disables all other modifiers and enables all unlocked powerups

Powerups
Drain Shot

 now creates a projectile that needs to be caught in order to gain the benefits
 killing enemies only grants healing, catching the new projectile without killing an enemy reduces the cooldown and returns the powerup now
 failing to kill an enemy will no longer cause any self damage

Hivemind

 there are now diminishing returns for each use of the powerup

Space Strike

 adjusted the targeting sprite

Boom Buddies

 fixed an issue where swapping powerups while the powerup was active would put a cooldown on the other slot

Flashback

 you no longer fire bullets at all enemies on use
 the invulnerability gained on use has been significantly reduced
 you now activate a short period of time slow if you didn't heal using the rewind
 you now have to go through a brief period of end lag if you healed from the rewind

Suspicious Substance

 now additionally increases blink distance
 now additionally decreases blink cooldown
 now additionally increases bullet fire rate

Cheesy Goodness

 decreased the speed of the cheese pot by about 50%
 decreased cooldown from 12 seconds to 9 seconds
 decreased duration from 15 seconds to 3 seconds
 increased damage from 2 damage/frame to 8 damage/frame
 the pool of cheese now destroys bullets
 the pool of cheese is no longer a lure
 removed the manual detonation on the pot of cheese
 reduced time until the cheese spills from the pot by about 75%

Gem of Strength

 reduced the time gained from getting a kill from 1/4th of a second to 1/6th of a second

Gem of Sacrifice

 decreased cooldown from 20 seconds to 14 seconds
 you now lose the powerup if you take damage while it's active
 removed the kill tracking from the powerup entirely
 losing the powerup while it's active will result in an effect that damages every enemy
 you can now stop the powerup early and begin it's cooldown

Gambler's Fallacy

 no longer fires a projectile regardless of the roll
 the dice have completely new effects
[olist]
[1] consume the powerup and heal 25% of health, with no effect at max health
[2] fire a set of dice that create a shocking tripwire to damage enemies as they travel
[3] summon a set of revolving dice to fire additional bullets at enemies for a brief period
[4] conjure a set of dice the will move outward, damaging enemies and destroying bullet in their path
[5] fire a barrage of exploding dice forward
[6] create a set of dice that will revolve around you, fire lasers outward as they do so
[/olist]

Widow's Web

 removed the slowing effect 

Crooked Deal

 decreased cooldown from 11 seconds to 9 seconds
 now fires a single card
 the card now has piercing properties
 the card now has a set damage value at 50 damage/frame
 the cards effects have been altered
[olist]
[heart] dealing damage with the card recharges the cooldown faster
[diamond] enemies killed with the card create a shattering effect
[club] dealing damage with the card spawns bees
[spade] while dealing damage, the card moves slower
[/olist]

Alarm Clock

 there are now diminishing returns for each use of the powerup

Lightning Rod

 the lightning rod no longer lures enemies
 the lightning rod no longer spends charges if no enemies are near it
 increased damage of each strike from 75 damage to 125 damage

Refire Rounds

 bullets no longer gain increased potency from hitting an enemy
 increased bullet damage bonus from 2x damage to 3x damage
 removed the ricochet effect from the bullet entirely
 bullets are refired once after hitting an enemy or after hitting the arena border

Ice Machine

 decreased bullet damage multiplier from 3x damage to 2x damage
 increased duration from 5 seconds to 7 seconds
 increased cooldown from 11 seconds to 12 seconds

Cross Beams

 increased damage of each beam from 12 damage/frame to 16 damage/frame
 the beams now spin around you

Jalapeno Popper

 formerly known as the Jalapeno Bomb
 there is no longer a duration attached to the powerup
 the jalapeno is no longer a lure
 the jalapeno splits into 3 smaller jalapenos upon exploding
 the jalapeno splits 5 times total
 base explosion damage increased from 750 damage to 1000 damage
 explosion damage scales with jalapeno splits
 the explosions now delete bullets
 increased time the jalapeno travels before exploding
 decreased rate at which the jalapeno slows down
 you can now manually detonate the jalapeno

Table

 the table no longer reflects bullets, it just deletes bullets
 removed the sweet spot that didn't work anyways
 you now throw the table

Tactical Penguin

 adjusted the targeting sprite
 there is no longer a duration attached to the powerup
 the targeting reticle no longer acts as a lure
 increased number of airstrikes from 1 to 4
 decreased damage of the explosion from 5250 damage to 250 damage
 decreased distance away from the user the targeting reticle spawns
 decreased time before the penguin hits the targeting reticle
 enemies near the targeting reticle when the penguin strikes are now frozen
 the explosion now additionally creates shatter shards

Egg Cannon

 increased fire rate from about 1/2 second to 1/4 second
 decreased damage of the egg from 350 damage to 200 damage
 decreased damage of the shells from 25 damage to 15 damage
 increased the velocity of the egg by about 50%
 the eggs will now automatically detonate if they will not hit anything

Line of Fire

 adjusted the targeting sprite

Engine Coolant

 now additionally decreases blink cooldown
 now additionally increases blink distance

Yummy Takoyaki

 when a piece of takoyaki absorbs a projectile, it now has a cooldown based on the number of takoyaki the player has

Cup of Coffee

 now capped at 50% powerup cooldown reduction


The next update is going to focus on overhauling enemies, as waves take too long and enemies feel scaled horribly as you get into the later waves

notes.title: v2.2.3 - More Display Updates
notes.content:
Added a new display option that allows you to change menu text colors and menu button colors
 Adjusted some of the menu button sprites
 Darkened the red while you are selecting an option in the menus
 Fixed an issue where the "Settings" text was tilted slightly
 Fixed an issue where the "Modifier Unlocked!" text wasn't using the new font rendering system
 Fixed an issue where some of the text in the Catalog was darker than intended
 Fixed an issue where some of the text in the Modifiers menu was darker than intended
 Fixed some incorrect spelling and corrected some grammar

notes.title: v2.2.2 - I Forgot Some Things
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the retry screen didn't have the proper alignment with lower display size settings
 Fixed an issue where the boss healthbar wasn't aligned on screen correctly with lower display size settings
 Fixed an issue where the player healthbar color was not the intended color when "Display UI" was not active

notes.title: v2.2.1 - Steam Deck and other smaller resolutions
notes.content:
Some simple changes to get the game playable on steamdecks and other systems with smaller resolutions. Also added in a new font rendering system so they are dynamically rendered during runtime instead of having to store like a dozen different sizes of the same font.


 removed wave objective text and wave flavor text for the relevant wave types
 added the relevant patch version to the patch notes page while viewing past patch notes
 changed the "choose craft" text to "customize ships"
 wave text has been sized up dramatically and relocated to the center of the screen
 added settings for smaller screen resolutions in the display settings
           -1280 x 720
           -960 x 540
 font rendering has been swapped to a new system that renders all fonts during runtime for dynamic scaling and better outlines
 lowered the speed of the menu cursor when using a controller by 50%
 fixed an issue where the controls screen swapped the inputs for "Swap Powerup" and "Display UI" while the keyboard control option was selected
 fixed an issue where you could see certain menu buttons you shouldn't see with lower brightness settings

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.2.0 - MORE
notes.content:
More new stuff and a lot of tuning adjustments and reworks to try and keep things fun, but fair.


Ship Selection:	

 added 4 new ship frames
 added 4 new ship colors
 adjusted purple and gray colors to be a little lighter
 added the ability to change slightly how your bullet looks with a toggle

Player:

 slightly adjusted bullet visuals and collision
 adjusted how bullet aim works 

 checks on creation for an enemy to constantly track
 no longer checks every couple of frames if it doesn't have a target
 it only misses if it's target wasn't there when it was created or if it's target died

 freeze shatter shard damage decreased from 50 damage to 25 damage
 adjusted the collision mask of all fire

Powerups:
Incinerator Drone:

 adjusted how the coloring works on the drone

Cannon Comrades:

 decreased homing value for bullets shot from the cannons from 1 to 0
 adjusted how the coloring works on the cannons

Hivemind:

 additionally activates upon use

Boom Buddy:

 changed name to Boom Buddies
 changed tagline
 now spawns 10 in a circle formation instead of 1
 no longer has health

 no longer applies the sauce debuff when killed
 can infinitely absorb bullets until destroyed

 no longer fires bullets when hit
 explodes when an enemy comes near
 decreased explosion size by ~1/2
 explosion damage decreased from 2750 to 250
 explosion now also applies a corrosion debuff to enemies

Kettle Cannons:

 changed the kernels to become reskinned bullets instead

 kernels have a homing value of 2
 instead of exploding randomly or on a kill, all kernels explode
 decreased firing delay when fully spun up from 2 frames to 3 frames

Strike!:

 increased cooldown refresh threshold from 5 to 10
 increased size of the bowling ball by ~33%

Sploda Can:

 failing to throw the soda can no longer damages the player
 explosion damage from failing to throw the soda can increased from 3500 to 6000

 this increases the damage over time after the explosion from 2 damage/frame to 3 damage/frame


Gem of Void:

 adjusted how the coloring works on the void

Gas Grenade:			

 duration decreased from 12 seconds to 4 seconds
 stink cloud linger duration decreased from 6 seconds to 4 seconds
 stink cloud damage decreased from 3 damage/frame to 2 damage/frame

Alarm Clock:

 additionally activates upon use

Horrific Belch:

 decreased the damage of the projectile from 100 damage/frame to 50 damage/frame

Frosted Icing:

 icing is now destroyed when it shatters a bullet
 reduced number of shards created when shattering a bullet from 10 to 8
 reduced trail duration from 5.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds

Stink Blink:

 blink clone linger duration decreased from 8 seconds to 5 seconds
 stink cloud damage decreased from 3 damage/frame to 2 damage/frame

Ceiling Fan:

 adjusted how the coloring works on the fan
 adjusted the sprite of the fan

Spin Dig:

 increased speed when passing through an enemy from 1 unit to 2 units

Bottle Rocket:

 changed tagline
 target is no longer chosen via distance, but by what's closest to where you're looking
 no longer charges up, now immediately launches
 base speed decreased from 35 units to 15 units
 now only has a single explosion

 damage increased from 2500 damage to 3500 damage
 the distance-based chain explosions that follow have been removed

 after the explosion, shrapnel-like projectiles are released in the direction the rocket was traveling

Synergies:

 adjusted internally how they work for both performance improvements and easier updates later

Laser Beam + Cannon Comrades:

 reduced the number of Cannon Comrades created from 5 to 4

Health Regen + Hero's Cape:

 heal from Health Regen while Hero's Cape is inactive reduced from 100% to 75%
 increased bullet homing while Hero's Cape is active from 2 to 5

Stop Watch + Spin Dig:

 drills no longer gain bonus damage from a time slow
 the drills no longer do damage while time is slowed
 decreased damage of the lasers from 12 damage per frame to 2 damage per frame
 increased the spread of the lasers

Drain Shot + Magical Shards:

 increased cooldown of Magical Shards while synergy is active from 10 seconds to 30 seconds

Acid Reflux + Horrific Belch:

 bullets fired from the player now require Acid Reflux to be active to destroy bullets
 bullets fired while Acid Reflux is active now only apply corrosion on death
 increased the spread of the belch projectiles by ~10 degrees
 belch projectiles additional corrosion decreased from 5 corrosion/frame to 2 corrosion/frame

Space Strike + Line Of Fire:

 decreased the number of airstrikes spawned by ~78%

Seek Saws + Frosted Icing:

 duration of icing trail left by saws reduced from 6 seconds to 1 second
 reduced number of shards created for shattering a bullet from 15 to 10
 frequency of icing trail left by saws reduced from 3 frames to 10 frames
 saws now create icing trail pieces individually, alternating between the saws

Boom Buddies + High Voltage:

 the plushies no longer turn and face towards enemies while firing

Kettle Cannons + Mega Microwave:

 kettles no longer fire double the kernels when shooting

Cheesy Goodness + BBQ Sauce:

 bullets fired now have a unique sprite
 bullets fired now also have a 1.5x size multiplier in addition to their increased potency

Atomic Knife + Atom's Apple:

 heal from Atom's Apple decreased from 100% to 50%

Sploda Can + Ice Machine:

 Sploda Can cooldown reduction from killing a frozen enemy reduced by about 50%

Gem Of Finality + Glitch Heart:

 heal from Glitch Heart while Gem of Finality is inactive decreased from 100% to 50%

Particle Wave + Beam Blade:

 Particle Wave projectiles no longer recieve a 2x damage bonus

Deadly Sneeze + Allergy Pills:

 heal from Allergy Pills decreased from 100% to 50%

Modifiers:

 All Together will now grant you a synergistic powerup that is unlocked and enabled when you pick up a powerup
 adjusted unlock requirements for All Together

 now unlocks when the catalog is opened
 can no longer be acquired by using the same synergy repeatedly
 increased number of synergies needed to unlock from 10 to 30

 adjusted unlock requirements for Forever Alone

 now unlocks when the catalog is opened
 can no longer be acquired by using the same synergy repeatedly
 increased number of synergies needed to unlock from 5 to 15

 if you have All Together and/or Forever Alone unlocked, it will become locked again

 if you have purchased them, you will be refunded 50 tickets each
 you can unlock them by opening the catalog while satisfying the requirements above


Bug Fixes:

 fixed an issue where a weird audio pop would happen while playing at random
 fixed an issue where the glow color the powerups had on the field when it was a possible synergy was based on the ship selected and not the color of the ship
 made the description of Sinister Sunbeam clearer
 made the description of Odorant clearer
 fixed an issue where the Safety Circle special wave would rarely cause a crash when completed
 fixed an issue for the following powerups that resulted in a larger collision box than intended, but adjusted the collision box to compensate

 Laser Beam
 Sinister Sunbeam
 Deletion Beam
 Cheesy Goodness
 Laser Sight (synergy variant)
 Sustainable Beam
 Swift Edge
 Beam Blade
 Paint Brush
 Cross Beams
 Chair
 Marble Buster
 Bullet Train
 Spin Dig
 Table
 Baseball Bat

 fixed an issue with the description of Baseball Bat
 fixed an issue where the same ship window would display for every ghost ship when they died
 fixed an issue where a player using a controller could enable and disable powerups while in the grid view of the catalog in the middle of a game
 fixed an issue where you couldn't look at the name of a powerup while in the grid view of the catalog in the middle of a game

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.1.0 - Some Goodies
notes.content:
Got some more stuff, some of which is bugs I didn't catch, and some of which are ideas I had after I put out the game

Menus:

Added a new button on the main menu that gives you the patch notes in game

Added a new button in the catalog that allows you to mass enable and disable powerups

 you can view this page in game, but it cannot be interacted with

Adjusted the ship selection menu:

 you can now change the color of your ship along with the frame
 everything in game has been adjusted for all ships having access to all colors
 just select the ship you want to change, and then select the frame and color to change it to

Bug Fixes:

fixed the Broken Heart's incorrect powerup description
fixed an issue where the Blink Turret would face an incorrect direction if spawned when no enemies were in the arena
fixed an issue where the game would crash if Cannon Comrades and Explosive Personality were active at the same time
fixed an issue where you could survive a hit with the Mortality modifier active via overhealth
Absorber Bubble now has a limit to how many bullets it can make to help with lag
fixed an issue where the game would crash if you died while the Gem of Finality's synergy variant was active on the frame a Particle Wave projectile was created
